about: Video engine Phase 0 settings (the MVP). Pinned by the PNF Video Engine Blueprint, MVP build spec (https://claude.ai/artifact/3ssi8yGEKVxiL7JTD87kzS); changing a value here is a logged decision in coo/DECISIONS-<date>.md, never a call made mid-run.
stopNote: Set true Nov 2, 2026, 9:00 pm in a live chat: Todd chose "Hold all 6" ("Nothing posts until a video made on the new line passes your watch-through") after setting the video principles (video/studio/PRINCIPLES.md). Posting, making and the lab pause; the build run on Thu Nov 5, 10:01 pm builds the new line (video/studio/REBUILD.md) and sends Todd one preview. Only Todd's word after that watch-through sets this back to false. Earlier meaning kept: set true by any live chat that hears Todd say "stop videos".
floorsNote: A and C floors are the blueprint's (d30 of 20 or more; closed30 of 20 or more). D's floor of 20: Todd, Oct 28, 3:43 am, "Go with recs" (coo/DECISIONS-2026-10-28.md).

voice.chosenNote: Todd picks one voice for all nine on the first preview (blueprint, Media and voice); until then the preview renders all five.

music.note: One bed from tools/music/library.json for all nine (blueprint: one music bed from our existing library). Quiet Math: calm, 84 bpm, 58.6 s, so it covers a 45 to 60 s cut.

cta.say: See your neighborhood free at proofnotfluff dot com slash rats.

lanes.note: Todd, live chat, Nov 1, 2026, 9:01 am: "go with your recommendation": 7-day test, 2 of 4 daily posts AI for trades (lane ai), 2 the current lessons (lane core), turn about in the posting line. Judged Nov 8 with `anim.py lanes`: ai at 2x core or better on shares + saves + follows per 1,000 views switches mode to ai (his go, same message); otherwise the numbers go to Todd. _shared/lanes.md.

posting.note: Todd, live chat, Nov 1, 2026, 12:09 pm: "Let's go down to 2 videos a day until we get the formula and structure correct to go viral. use the spare capacity to focus on developing quality videos". Kept lunch (11:37, our best Instagram read so far, lsa-missed-calls) and evening (8:13 pm); the morning and end-of-day post tasks are turned off, not deleted. Earlier: 3 a day (Oct 30), 4 a day (Oct 31, 9:08 am). Slots and evidence: video/studio/research/runs/2026-10-30-cadence.md; _shared/formula.md.
